title: fix(core): a row action's confirmText and param-dialog copy read the row as `record`, like the record header (objectui#12967)
body:
Fixes #12967
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changed

One rule for both doors: a row action's templates read the row as `record`, the way the record header's do.

- **`@object-ui/core` `ActionRunner`.** A new private `templateEvaluatorFor(action)` returns the evaluator a dispatch's authored copy is read through. When the dispatch carries a row under `params._rowRecord`, it binds that row as `record` for this dispatch only. The row wins over a page-level `record`, and the runner's own context is not touched. `confirmText` is read through it. The param-collection handler now receives a third argument, `interpolate`, bound to the same scope.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`.** Both param-collection handlers (`useConsoleActionRuntime`, `RecordDetailView`) apply `interpolate` to the localized `description`. The console handler does this BEFORE it joins the admin-override notice, because approver names are data and must never be read as a template. Both put `interpolate` on the dialog state. `ActionParamDialog` applies it to each param's `helpText` after an inline per-locale map is picked, so the hole is filled on the text the user reads.
- **No grid change.** `ObjectGrid` already passes the row as `_rowRecord`.

## Why the runner is the narrowest shared point (A1)

- **Header context, measured.** `RecordDetailView`'s `ActionProvider` context is `{ record: pageRecord or {}, objectName, objectFields?, user, org }`.
- **Grid context, measured.** The grid's row dispatch is `{ ...def, actionParams?, params: { _rowRecord: row } }`, fired through the list page's runner, whose context carries no `record`.
- **Why the runner.** Every row surface fires through `ActionRunner.execute`, and it is the one place `confirmText` is evaluated. Binding there fixes every row door at once.
- **Other callers that dispatch with a row, and whether they now get `record`:**
  - `ObjectGrid` row actions: yes. This is the card's door.
  - `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` (a related list's row actions): yes, and the child row now wins over the parent page's `record`.
  - `DeclaredActionsBar`: yes. It stashes the page record, so nothing changes.
  - `containers.tsx` page-header dispatch: yes. Same record.
  - `action-button.tsx` update write: yes. Same record.
  - `ObjectGrid`'s per-record bulk dispatch: not affected. It strips `confirmText` and the params before dispatch, and `BulkActionDialog` prints its own multi-row confirm. That dialog is out of scope (see Acceptance notes).
- **Why `interpolate` instead of pre-filling the strings.** The runner cannot fill `description` / `helpText` itself before calling the handler. The handler localizes that copy AFTER it receives it, either from a translation-bundle entry or from an inline per-locale map. A pre-filled literal would lose to an unfilled translation. That is why the runner hands over a function and not a filled string.

## Missing-field degradation (A2)

On the header, `${record.no_such_field}` reads `undefined` and the hole prints empty: `Pause ?`. Before this change the row printed the raw source. It now prints the same empty hole. A hole whose root is unbound (no row, no `record`) stays as authored, which is the evaluator's existing answer.

## Ruled scope

- No new action key.
- A toast's `${result.*}` is unchanged. Pin (d) covers this.
- The card's "refuse at declaration if a hole cannot be filled on some door" is not done. Both doors now fill, so no declaration-time check is added.

## Tests

Final head `9bcaded76f`.

- `packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.rowRecordTemplates-12967.test.ts` pins:
  - (a) `confirmText` is filled on the header and on the row;
  - the row wins over a page `record`;
  - (b) `interpolate` fills `description` / `helpText` on both doors;
  - (c) CONTROL: a missing field degrades the same way on both doors;
  - CONTROL: a dispatch without a row is unchanged;
  - (d) CONTROL: a toast's `${result.*}` is unchanged.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowActionRecordHole-12967.test.tsx` runs the same action through a real `ObjectGrid` row menu and through a header-shaped `ActionProvider`, for (a) and (c).
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.recordHoles-12967.test.tsx` checks that the real dialog fills a string `helpText` and a per-locale map `helpText`. CONTROL: without `interpolate`, `helpText` prints as authored.
- Handler cases were added to `RecordDetailView.paramDialogTitle.test.tsx` and `useConsoleActionRuntime.overrideNotice.test.tsx`. They cover: the description is filled after localization, the override notice is never interpolated, and `interpolate` reaches the state.
- `RecordDetailView.paramRuntimeParity-6431.test.tsx` lists the fields the dialog reads off its state. That list gains `interpolate`.
- **Ablation, run once.** `templateEvaluatorFor`'s `return new ExpressionEvaluator({ ...this.context, record: row });` was replaced with `return this.evaluator;` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor x1 to x0). Result: 6 failed, 2 passed. (a) went red on both files, for example `Expected "Pause Acme?" / Received "Pause ${record.display_name}?"`. (c) showed the pre-fix row degradation (raw source). The restore was proven by blob: `edf7176c00c7` after restore equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Tests resolve `@object-ui/core` to `src` through the root vitest alias, so no dist rebuild was involved.

## Gates (local, on `9bcaded76f`)

- **Type-check:** `type-check` exited 0 for core, app-shell and plugin-grid, after building the app-shell dependency closure. Every touched test is in its package's `tsconfig.test.json` file list (checked with `--listFilesOnly`).
- **Targeted vitest, one package at a time.** These are the new files plus every test file named after `ActionRunner`, `ActionParamDialog` or row actions, or naming `confirmText`, `_rowRecord` or the param handler:
  - core: 24 files, 376 tests;
  - app-shell: 37 files, 527 tests (the parity pin above went red, was updated and re-ran 9/9);
  - plugin-grid: 12 files, 145 tests;
  - the rest: 22 files, 537 tests.
- **Not run locally:** whole-package directories. They are left to CI.
- **eslint, narrowed to the 10 changed files** (`--no-inline-config`, JSON format): 10 files, 0 errors. The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- **Battery: exit 0 on all of these.** `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- **`check:spec-floors`:** exit 1. This is pre-existing on main, as the dispatch noted. No manifest is touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not filed: `BulkActionDialog`'s confirm.** It prints `def.confirmText` raw for a multi-row selection. There is no single `record` there, so a `${record.*}` hole cannot be filled by this rule. Observation only.
- **Changeset.** `@object-ui/core` minor (the widened exported `ParamCollectionHandler`), `@object-ui/app-shell` patch. The plugin-grid change is a test file only.

The implementing session is `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` (seat `domain:ui#2`).
